content: GHSA-444r-cwp2-x5xf / CVE-2026-3635: fastify <=5.8.2 request.protocol/request.host getters read X-Forwarded-Proto/X-Forwarded-Host from ANY connection (even untrusted ones bypassing the proxy) when trustProxy is a restrictive function/IP/subnet — fixed in 5.8.3+. Kurzly's fastify is pinned ^5.10.0 (patched) and TRUST_PROXY is a plain boolean (env.ts), not a restrictive function, so not directly exposed, but confirms request.hostname/X-Forwarded-Host must never be trusted for security decisions without explicit allowlist validation against the Domain table.
